messages:
anya: Watching the live rollout dashboard for convoflow v7.1.0 -> 8% global. Small spike in p99 and a couple of 5xx in eu-west-2. Can we gate the next percent step?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout in progress: convoflow v7.1.0 -> 8% global at 3410000000. Health: degraded, errors 0.5% (baseline 0.04%), p99 +150ms.

ops-max: Can someone paste the quick graf link and call out region breakdown?

anya: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/convoflow-live  eu-west-2 shows p99 ~680ms and 0.9% errors; other regions near baseline.

tino: If it's concentrated in eu-west-2 we should hold global step and either pin eu-west-2 or drain that region only. Pinning is less disruptive.

claire: Agreed. Proposed routing pin command:```sh
redwood routing override --svc convoflow --region eu-west-2 --target v7.0.8 --note "hold: elevated p99/5xx during 8% canary"
```

product-raj: Quick check: any automated rollback thresholds triggered? We have alerts for sustained errors >1.0% for 5m. This is under that for now.

ops-max: I'll create a ROUTE ticket and execute the override if we all agree. Also recommend we add temporary request sampling for stack traces in eu-west-2 to the ticket.

anya: +1 to pin and sampling. Also ask infra to check tokenizer warmup on the affected nodegroup.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override request #ROUTE-91011 created by ops-max. Status: pending-exec.

ops-max: Executing routing override now. Running command and attaching sampling config.

(18s)

ops-max: Done. eu-west-2 pinned to v7.0.8 and sampling enabled. Verified traffic shifted back to stable hosts; observed p99 drop to near-baseline ~45s after pin. :white_check_mark:

anya: Nice. Leaving global canary config at 8% but effectively drained in eu-west-2. HOLD on any further percent bumps or cross-region promotions.

tino: Rollback thresholds to keep on the ticket: sustained errors >=1.2% for 5m OR p99 >= 900ms for 10m -> full rollback to v7.0.8 and cancel other region canaries.

claire: I'll update release notes with a short note: "Partial pause in eu-west-2 due to elevated tail latency; routing pinned to prior stable; investigating."

product-raj: Product ops aware. Will coordinate customer comms only if we move to global rollback.

ops-max: Assigning to infra/serving for tokenizer warmup and nodegroup health; setting alert for thresholds. Closing this hold call unless the metrics deteriorate.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary status updated -> HOLD (8%) by ops-max at 3410000278.

anya: Ack. Reopen if we need to escalate to rollback.
